Is this for complete beginners?+

Yes. If you can use a browser and follow a screen recording, you can follow the workflows. No coding background is required.

What is included in the founding pass?+

The course package covers Module 1, the 5-Play Selector Matrix, the Copy-Paste Prompt Vault, five practical workflows, and private club support. Review the current payment schedule at checkout.

How do billing and cancellation work?+

Checkout shows the introductory charge, follow-on billing schedule, and cancellation terms. Review those details before continuing.

What kind of support is included?+

Ask for sample critiques and help with prompts, offers, or outreach in the private club. Get focused help in weekly sessions. Founding members receive 1-on-1 support until their first client.

Are tools included? Is income guaranteed?+

AI tools have their own terms and usage limits; optional paid upgrades are separate. Income is not guaranteed. Your results depend on your work, market demand, and ability to find and serve clients.

Can I join now?+

Choose the founding offer to open checkout and review your order before continuing.
